# San Marino

[global-law](../) / San Marino

1 repository under this folder (1 legislation, whole country). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 75% | 20% (estimate, low confidence, 14.6–27.3%) | not applicable | 0% |

The repository holds the Consiglio Grande e Generale's 65 testi coordinati (409 distinct acts, many only in part, 7,535 article files), including the Dichiarazione dei Diritti, the Codice Penale, the 1878 Codice di Procedura Penale and the Legge sulle società, with text matching the official PDFs word for word in the checks; but it is current-only, it is a subject selection rather than the whole statute book, and it holds no case law. In the Dichiarazione the 1974 text is filed under the wrong act (legge-costituzionale-2025-2) and the annexed amending acts are merged into it.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
